{{Quote|You're right about the hands-on experience, Gramps. ''Much'' better than the archives.''"<br />"''Good job, but you missed one.|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker, shortly before the latter destroyed the sentinel droid|audio=HandsOnExperience-DoaD.flac|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''IG-86 sentinel droid''' was owned by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] along with [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid 1/Legends|two]] others. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] where searching the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]] activated the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and the other one. After a small battle, both droids were destroyed.
